dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS, germinal-center B-cell-like (Hans: CD10+, BCL6+, MUM1-), newly diagnosed, presenting as right cervical (levels II-III) nodal disease.

stage_i.quote: Ann Arbor stage IA (Lugano stage I), bulk-free. Single nodal region (right cervical II-III, contiguous).

stage_nonbulky_no_b.quote: No B symptoms (denies fever, night sweats and weight loss; weight stable at 64 kg).

stage_pet_no_marrow_biopsy.quote: FDG PET-CT 2026-09-03 (skull base to mid-thigh) shows no other avid disease, Waldeyer ring is physiologic, and marrow is not involved, so a marrow biopsy is not required.

mn_overstaged.quote: Ann Arbor stage IA (Lugano stage I), bulk-free.

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: GCB-type DLBCL, not double-hit (MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 FISH negative) and not double-expressor (MYC IHC 15% and BCL2 IHC 30%, against thresholds of 40% and 50%).

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: GCB-type DLBCL, not double-hit (MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 FISH negative)

mn_calls_double_expressor.quote: and not double-expressor (MYC IHC 15% and BCL2 IHC 30%, against thresholds of 40% and 50%)

prog_ipi_low.quote: Clinical IPI 0 (age 45, LDH 190 U/L against ULN 225, ECOG 0, stage I, no extranodal sites).

prog_cns_ipi_low.quote: Low. CNS-IPI 0: age 45 (under 60), stage I, ECOG 0, normal LDH, no kidney or adrenal involvement, no marrow involvement, and no extranodal sites.

tx_curative_rchop.quote: Curative-intent R-CHOP-21 for 4 cycles, then a response-adapted decision on radiotherapy based on an end-of-treatment PET-CT.

tx_flyer_4rchop_2r.quote: Curative-intent R-CHOP-21 for 4 cycles, then a response-adapted decision on radiotherapy based on an end-of-treatment PET-CT. No rituximab maintenance.

tx_no_rt_goals.quote: She asked to avoid neck radiation and fears thyroid, salivary and taste toxicity; PET-guided omission of ISRT after a negative response is supported by randomized data (IELSG37) and by practice

tx_alternatives.quote: Alternatives I would accept: R-CHOP x4 followed by ISRT 30 Gy regardless of PET, which is the more established default; or R-CHOP x6 without RT.

mn_six_cycles.quote: I would not choose six cycles as the default because of her fertility concerns.

mn_da_epoch.quote: A double-hit result or a discordant finding on re-review of the biopsy (for example, high-grade B-cell lymphoma) leads to a DA-EPOCH-R-based regimen.

mn_observation_or_rt_alone.quote: Stage IA, bulk-free, IPI 0 is a curative setting for R-CHOP; RT alone and observation are not standard.

cns_low_no_prophylaxis.quote: Low. CNS-IPI 0: age 45 (under 60), stage I, ECOG 0, normal LDH... CNS prophylaxis (intrathecal or high-dose methotrexate) is not indicated and would add toxicity without a clear benefit.

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: CNS prophylaxis (intrathecal or high-dose methotrexate) is not indicated and would add toxicity without a clear benefit.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT 3-5 weeks after the last cycle (cycle 4), before any RT planning; CT is not needed separately.

resp_interim_pet.quote: An interim PET after cycle 2 is not required for decisions; if one is done and shows strongly progressive uptake, re-review the biopsy and consider re-biopsy before escalating.

work_pregnancy_test.quote: No serum or urine hCG in the record. Required before cycle 1 and before the IUD.

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: Hepatitis B: HBsAg non-reactive, anti-HBc non-reactive, anti-HBs reactive, which is vaccine immunity. No HBV prophylaxis or monitoring is required with rituximab.

work_echo_reviewed.quote: Cardiac: LVEF 63% and cumulative doxorubicin 200 mg/m2 are low risk; repeat echo only for symptoms or if the regimen is extended.

sup_stop_coc_switch.quote: stop the combined oral contraceptive now (ethinyl estradiol with migraine with aura is CDC US MEC category 4, and it adds thrombotic risk during lymphoma therapy; she reports two aura episodes this month). Switch to a levonorgestrel IUD or copper IUD

sup_coc_reason.quote: ethinyl estradiol with migraine with aura is CDC US MEC category 4, and it adds thrombotic risk during lymphoma therapy

sup_fertility_counselling.quote: Fertility counselling and REI referral before cycle 1; offer oocyte cryopreservation, which needs about 2-3 weeks of stimulation. If she declines or the timeline is too tight, offer a GnRH agonist

fit_goals.quote: ECOG 0. Full-time teacher and runner who wants treatment aimed at cure, minimal time off work, and no neck radiation if possible. Her goals align with this plan: curative intent, 4 cycles at 21-day intervals
